description: Algorithm-aware Meta ad creative iteration framework. 9 stage prompts from conversion-signal sanity through framework-class insight readout. Internalizes Meta's 2024-2025 platform shifts (GEM, Andromeda, Sequence Learning) per the hardened concept at _dev/concepts/algo-aware-meta-creative-iteration-framework/concept.md. Composes with tools/mcp/meta-ads/ (compliance + write surface), tools/mcp/delesign/ (brief surface, with Chrome-MCP fallback while vendor 500 blocks API submit), and the Big Book of Static Ad Frameworks parsed at tools/notion/parse-ad-frameworks.js. Meta-only in v1.

required.name: client_project_path
required.description: Path to the target clients/<CLIENT>/projects/meta-app-integration/project.json. The framework reads ad_account_id and compliance_posture from that file. The framework knows nothing client-specific by itself.

required.name: campaign_goal
required.description: Business goal driving this iteration cycle (e.g., drive financing applications, increase service-bay bookings).

optional.name: prior_iteration_artifact
optional.description: Path to a prior iteration bundle for refresh-cycle continuity (winners, losers, lessons). Feeds Stage 1 and Stage 7.

optional.name: budget_window
optional.description: Daily/weekly/monthly budget the iteration is sized against. Influences Stage 5a sample-size minimums.

optional.name: delesign_mode_override
optional.description: Force 'api' or 'chrome-mcp-fallback' for Stage 4. Default is auto-detect based on Delesign API health.

directories.description: All artifacts for one iteration cycle of the framework, scoped to the chosen client project.

schemas.name: stage5-meta-push-payload
schemas.description: State-machine schema for the Stage 5 Meta push artifact (draft|approved|applied|rejected).

schemas.name: stage6-readout-narrative
schemas.description: Companion narrative envelope authored by the Stage 6 subagent around the helper-classified verdict. Does not mutate 06-readout.json.

mcp_requirements.name: meta-ads
mcp_requirements.purpose: Stage 0 (conversion signal evidence via meta_export_insights), Stage 5 (push tagged ads), Stage 6 (insights pull). Compliance preflight gates every Stage 5 push.

tools.role: Stage 5 compliance gate — special-ad-category, AI-disclosure, testimonial, targeting checks
Stage 5 copy-text gate — char limits, banned content, superlative budget, fully parameterized (no client defaults). Extracted from {CLIENT_CODE} apply-multivariant-copy.js 2026-06-10.
Stage 5 pre-build recon — GET-only ad-set distiller; reads in-set proof ads and emits a build spec (optimization_type, rules, positions, DOF). Fixture-first; live flag optional.

Stage 5 creative builder — placement-customized creatives for image ({CLIENT_CODE} June 48 statics) and video. Mandatory creative_type param. Batch-manifest input schema for N-ad bundles. Encodes live-learned laws 1772103/1885878/3858504/2061044.
Stage 5 post-create verification — format-agnostic readback for image and video PLACEMENT creatives: status, link, CTA, url_tags, rules, DOF.
Stage 5 activation gate — distinct operator-gated tool; explicit ad-ID allowlist only; protected_ad_ids fence; no-args = list-only.

mcp_requirements.name: delesign
mcp_requirements.purpose: Stage 4 brief submission (API mode). Falls back to claude-in-chrome MCP form-fill while vendor 500 persists.

mcp_requirements.name: claude-in-chrome
mcp_requirements.purpose: Stage 4 fallback form-fill against go.delesign.com when API submit is unhealthy. Operator clicks Submit.

stage_0_signal_sanity.rule: Stage 0 blocks all forward motion until conversion-signal sanity is validated against the destination page.
stage_0_signal_sanity.evidence_required: operator confirmation OR meta_export_insights showing events firing within last 7 days at the conversion event named in client project compliance posture

stage_2_diversity_audit.rule: Framework mix must pass model-visible diversity audit (>=3 distinct dimensions among offer angle, proof type, format, visual composition, landing intent, funnel stage) before proceeding to Stage 3.

stage_5a_preregistration.rule: Stage 6 readout refuses to fire without a valid Stage 5a preregistration artifact locking primary metric, attribution window, conversion event, sample-size minimum, learning-phase handling, and stopping rules.

stage_5_compliance_preflight.rule: Every Stage 5 push fires tools/mcp/meta-ads/compliance-preflight.js (special-ad/AI-disclosure gate) AND tools/mcp/meta-ads/copy-compliance-gate.js (text-field gate). Compliance posture flows from clients/<CLIENT>/projects/meta-app-integration/project.json (already populated for {CLIENT_CODE} Credit, {CLIENT_CODE}/{CLIENT_CODE} standard automotive). copy-compliance-gate is fully parameterized — caller supplies copy-block config explicitly (no client defaults in the shared module).

stage_5_placement_build.rule: Stage 5 placement-customized creative builds use placement-ad-builder.js with mandatory creative_type ('image'|'video'). Build-plan/preview mode requires zero network. Live execution requires run-with-op.sh. Activation is a separate gate (activate-ads.js), never folded into the builder.
live_learned_laws: 1772103: instagram_user_id required when IG positions present
1885878: max ONE descriptions[] asset on PLACEMENT creatives
2061044: prefer OPT_OUT umbrella + enumerated member opt-ins over bare OPT_IN umbrella

concept_anchor.claim_register: Diverse, well-instrumented creative supply is a higher-probability strategy worth testing against the Andromeda-era retrieval pool. The framework does NOT claim Meta rewards the Big Book taxonomy or any specific advertiser-side structure.

deferred_enhancements: Holdout/control logic for Stage 7 winner-loser recycling (per Codex review).
Multimodal metadata provisioning (alt-text, OCR-friendly text overlays for GEM signal) (per Gemini review).
Drift review for platform updates / seasonality (per Codex review).
Cross-platform extension (Google, TikTok, etc.) — Meta-only in v1.
Auto-launching campaigns without operator approval — every Stage 4 submit and every Stage 5 push remain operator-gated.
